title: Pete on the Helm
style: 92 bpm, gritty post-punk rap, baritone male lead, female lead alternating, gang shouts, overdriven bass guitar, angular guitar stabs, tom-heavy live drums, vinyl crackle, dry room reverb, family anthem energy
lyrics:
[Intro - Fem Lead, soft over vinyl crackle]
Dockside lights, the river runs slow
Pete on the helm, the family knows

[Verse 1 - Male Rap, baritone]
My brother on the wheel, steel under his hand
Brandon tuned the engines, that's how the Pelican stands
Swan River rolling, Perth city beside
Family business, family pride
No comments, no posts, no scrolling feed
Just real water, real wood, real speed

[Pre-Chorus - Fem Lead]
Pete steady, Brandon ready
The boat is heavy, the crew is heady
No machines between us, just hands on the wheel
Three thirty six, the family is real

[Chorus - Duet, gang shouts]
Pete on the helm — Pete on the helm!
Brandon in the engine room — holding the realm!
Pelican on the river — Pelican on the bay!
Family first — family always — every day!

[Verse 2 - Male Rap, deeper]
Not every operator runs alone
Some got brothers, some got their own
I got Pete, I got Brandon on the line
I got the river, I got the salt brine
Eight sites running, I still call home
The Pelican's a family, the family's a poem

[Bridge - spoken, Male, dry]
No Keel claim. No rank. Just brothers.
One on the helm, one in the engine, one on the wire.
Three thirty six — same fire.

[Outro - gang shouts fading]
Pete! — Brandon! — Pelican!
Family — family — family run!
Swan River roll — Perth city light
Pete on the helm — holding the night
